advice.summary: 3 defects found. Most serious: short circuit (copper bridge) (critical) at centre.

steps.name: Short circuit (copper bridge)
steps.cause: Under-etching: etch time too short, etchant weak or cold, or spray pressure low, leaving copper between conductors.
steps.action: Check the etch line: conveyor speed, etchant concentration and temperature, and spray pressure.
steps.source: Carano 2020: copper left in narrow gaps across the panel = under-etch (speed, temperature, spray pressure); lane: Dietz 2011 (one etch nozzle); centre: Ball 2022, etchant puddles at the panel centre
steps.confirm: Check etch conveyor speed, etchant temperature and spray pressure; shorts from under-etch appear in fine gaps all over the board.
steps.why: It is in the middle of the board, which points to under-etching.

steps.name: Spur (copper protrusion)
steps.cause: Under-etching left copper attached to the conductor edge.
steps.action: If the class allows repair, trim the protrusion following IPC-7721 and re-measure spacing.
steps.source: Carano 2020: copper left at conductor edges = under-etch; lane: Dietz 2011 (one etch nozzle); centre: Ball 2022, etchant puddles at the panel centre
steps.confirm: Check etch speed, temperature and spray pressure; spurs from under-etch appear along many edges.
steps.why: It is in the middle of the board, which points to under-etching.

steps.name: Spurious copper (copper island)
steps.cause: Contamination on the panel before etching.
steps.action: If the class allows repair, remove the island following IPC-7721.
steps.source: Our inference: particles shielding copper land at random places
steps.confirm: Check panel cleaning and cleanroom practice before etch; random islands point to contamination.

alternatives.cause: Contamination on the panel before etching.
alternatives.confirm: Check panel cleaning and cleanroom practice before etch; random islands point to contamination.

alternatives.cause: Incomplete etching in that area, often from poor etchant flow.
alternatives.confirm: Compare the centre with the edges of the panel; copper left in the centre points to etch puddling.

steps.why: Contamination before etching is likely: the same spot was hit on 0 of the last 2 boards.
